notes.title: Double line confrontation: New World is now open for trial
notes.notes:
The time has come to 2022/12/18. Today, we officially launch the "Double Line Battle": New World Trial. The Chinese version may be followed up. At this stage, only English is supported
The game opens a map of the search and rescue center. The player's task is to explore the search and rescue center. I hope you have a good time
